mapper.insert: INSERT INTO animations (company_id, title, image_path, summary, season, review_count, bookmark_count, rating_sum, release_date) VALUES ((SELECT company_id FROM companies WHERE name = #{companyName} LIMIT 1), #{title}, #{thumbnailImagePath}, #{summary}, #{season}, #{reviewCount}, #{bookmarkCount}, #{ratingSum}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE animations SET title = #{title}, image_path = #{thumbnailImagePath}, summary = #{summary}, season = #{season} WHERE animation_id = #{id}
